stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra with "Anything you can do on a computer, Astra can do for you. Fast." The launch video got 340K likes, and Sam Altman called it the start of "a new generation of entrepreneurship, scientific discovery, and building". It went live in ChatGPT for Pro, Enterprise and Business Premium users and in the API.
